heading: Israeli raids, attacks, arrests continue in occupied West Bank and Gaza
body: Settler raids and attacks in the occupied West Bank, often under Israeli police protection, continued on Friday.

heading: More Araghchi quotes from call with UK counterpart
body: We now have more quotes from Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi during his phone call with UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband, according to Iran’s Tasnim news.

heading: WATCH: The US faces a strategic ‘dead end’ in Iran, analyst says
body: Washington has reached a strategic impasse with Iran, says a former analyst for the US Congress.
